arcs.title: The Second Circle
arcs.summary: Day 2: The three-word margin note has been identified as a trail name — Harlan's Hollow, four miles north-northeast, named on older charts and absent from newer ones. The table now holds the ordnance chart, a trail guide from Steve's jacket, and a recovery rope of unexplained but unquestioned presence. Christine has the access road; Steve has opinions recorded in his own word, which differs from 'orderly.' The Jeep is humming. The Ministry has placed the hollow on a list under consideration for future consideration. Departure window: not this weekend, but narrowing. Day 3 should bring one more preparation item — a mechanical thing Steve produces from the garage, or something Christine adds to the access-road notes — and possibly the first outside voice: someone who has been to the hollow, or claims to have, and has something to say about it.
